name: Force Quit
description: Last resort when every move is out of Cycles. Ends the foe's process the hard way; the user takes recoil. Never learned.

name: Bump
description: Bumps into the foe like a loose mouse.

name: Double Click
description: Clicks the foe twice in quick succession.

name: Keyboard Smash
description: Mashes random keys at the foe 2 to 5 times.

name: Screen Glare
description: Turns the brightness to max. Lowers the foe's accuracy.

name: Heatsink Slam
description: Slams with a hot heatsink. May leave the foe Overheated.

name: Thermal Runaway
description: Lets heat build until it spills out. May leave the foe Overheated.

name: Hard Reset
description: Holds the power button down on the foe. The user takes some recoil.

name: Overclock
description: Pushes clock speeds past spec. Sharply raises Throughput.

name: Chassis Guard
description: Bolts on an extra side panel. Raises Hardening.

name: Ping
description: Sends an echo request that hits on the way back.

name: Packet Flood
description: Drowns the foe in a wave of packets.

name: Fast Ethernet
description: A wired strike that always goes first.

name: Latency Spike
description: Adds 900 ms of lag to everything the foe does. Throttles it.

name: Bandwidth Hog
description: Starts a giant download. Sharply raises Bandwidth.

name: Code Injection
description: Runs code inside the foe and keeps half the damage as Uptime.

name: Refactor
description: Tears the foe apart and puts it back together worse.

name: Infinite Loop
description: while(true). The foe starts Looping.

name: Patch Up
description: Applies a hotfix. Restores half of max Uptime.

name: Static Zap
description: A shock from shuffling across carpet. May Throttle the foe.

name: Brownout
description: Drops the voltage on the whole area. May Throttle the foe.

name: Sleep Mode
description: Triggers the power-saving timer. The foe goes on Standby.

name: Infect
description: Slips a payload into the foe. It becomes Infected.

name: Worm Burrow
description: Tunnels through the foe's cabling. May Infect it.

name: Spam Blast
description: Fires 2 to 5 unsolicited messages.

name: Phish
description: Asks the foe to verify its password. May lower its Encryption.

name: Data Dump
description: Unloads a huge CSV on the foe. May lower its Compute.

name: Blue Screen
description: A fatal exception aimed at the foe. May leave it Hung.

name: Defrag
description: Tidies up its sectors. Raises Hardening and Encryption.

name: Firewall Up
description: Denies all inbound traffic. Sharply raises Encryption.

name: Cloud Burst
description: Scales up suddenly and rains data on the foe.

name: Burn Rule
description: Pyrewall's signature. A firewall rule that burns blocked packets. 30% chance to Overheat.

name: Ash Reboot
description: Collapses into ash and cold-boots with a fresh ruleset. Restores half its Uptime.

name: Lid Slam
description: Clawptop's signature. Slams a laptop lid on the foe. May lower its Hardening.

name: Power Cycle
description: Turns the foe off and on again, hard. May Throttle it.

name: Thermal Exhaust
description: Opens the cabinet door and blasts hot exhaust. May leave the foe Overheated.

name: Switch On
description: Flips from 0 to 1 faster than the foe can react. Always goes first.

name: Logic Gate
description: Routes a gold circuit trace through the foe. May lower its Compute.

name: Fab Line
description: Siliqueen's signature. A line of fresh workers marches over the foe 2 to 5 times.

name: Coolant Spray
description: Snorts cold coolant at the foe. May lower its Bandwidth.

name: Thermal Flood
description: Coolapotamus's signature. A cold wave of coolant rolls over the foe.

name: Spin Up
description: Spins up to speed and rolls into the foe. Raises the user's Bandwidth.

name: Overapply
description: Pasteslug's signature. Smears way too much thermal paste on the foe. Sharply lowers its Bandwidth.

name: Render
description: Pixelsier's signature. Renders a picture straight into the foe's eyes. May lower its accuracy.

name: Bundle Up
description: Tieweaver's signature. Zip-ties the foe into a neat bundle. May Throttle it.

name: Web Mesh
description: Meshpider's signature. Wraps the foe in a hexagonal mesh. Sharply lowers its Bandwidth.

name: World Wide Web
description: Arachnet's signature. Catches the foe in a web that spans the valley. May Throttle it.

name: Fiber Spout
description: Calfiber's signature. Spouts a jet of glowing light. May lower the foe's Hardening.

name: Undersea Cable
description: Orcable's signature. Rams the foe with a lake-floor cable run.

name: Proxy Tunnel
description: Proxkit's signature. Strikes from a hidden tunnel and slips away. Raises the user's evasion.

name: Handshake
description: Hummodem's signature. Screeches a dial-up handshake, then speeds up. Raises Bandwidth.

name: Signal Sting
description: Jellyband's signature. Stings with a weak signal. May lower the foe's accuracy.

name: Murmuration
description: Murmuroute's signature. The whole flock re-routes through the foe 2 to 5 times.

name: Special Delivery
description: Storkache's signature. Drops a cached bundle on the foe from very high up.

name: Hotkey Macro
description: Mashes one shortcut that runs a whole script at the foe. Nobody remembers recording it.

name: Tether
description: Shares its connection with the foe, then burns through the whole data plan.

name: Cert Spark
description: Checks the foe's certificate with a sharp spark. May Throttle it.

name: Brick Wing
description: Swings a wing of solid firewall bricks. May Overheat the foe.

name: Rate Limit
description: Allows the foe one request a minute. Throttles it.

name: Ember Outage
description: Lets the flames inside its wings out for one burst. May Throttle the foe.

name: Cheek Flash
description: Its heatsink cheeks glint in the foe's eyes. Lowers accuracy.

name: Twin Fans
description: Both tail fans spin up and strike, twice.

name: Heat Pipe
description: Pipes stored cheek heat straight into the foe. May Overheat it.

name: Uptime Streak
description: Brags about its uptime and digs in. Raises Hardening and Encryption.

name: Status LEDs
description: Blinks every belly LED at once. Lowers the foe's accuracy.

name: Backbone Surge
description: Sends the whole valley's traffic through the foe at once.

name: Cursor Blink
description: Blinks its tail cursor right in the foe's face. Lowers accuracy.

name: Stack Trace
description: Prints a wall of error lines at the foe. May lower its Compute.

name: Sandbox
description: Runs itself in a sealed sandbox. Sharply raises Encryption.

name: Wriggle Rush
description: Wriggles into the foe 2 to 5 times.

name: Backdoor
description: Leaves a hidden way in. May lower the foe's Encryption.

name: Event Horizon
description: Folds space so the foe falls into the wormhole.

name: Junk Payload
description: Drops an attachment nobody should open. Infects the foe.

name: Line Strike
description: Strikes down its own cable run. Always goes first.

name: Tracert
description: Hops along every switch on the way to the foe.

name: Tangle
description: Wraps the foe in loose cable. Throttles it.

name: Crosstalk
description: Cross-wires every pair so the foe hears all of them.

name: Shed Jacket
description: Sheds its old cable jacket. Sharply raises Bandwidth.

name: Write Protect
description: Slides its write-protect tab shut. Raises Hardening and Encryption.

name: Disk Swap
description: Ejects and reinserts itself into the foe, twice.

name: Bit Rot
description: Old sectors crumble onto the foe. May lower its Compute.

name: Read-Only
description: Sets itself to read-only. Sharply raises Encryption.

name: Dust Cloud
description: Shakes out a cloud of lint. Lowers the foe's accuracy.

name: Fan Blade
description: Slices with spinning 120 mm blades. May Overheat the foe.

name: Airflow
description: Spins every fan to full speed. Sharply raises Bandwidth.

name: Wheel Slam
description: Rolls its wheel into the foe. May Overheat it.

name: DIMM Pair
description: Hits with a matched pair of memory sticks, twice.

name: Turbo Wheel
description: Runs its wheel flat out. Sharply raises Throughput.

name: Memory Wipe
description: Clears everything at once, its own memory included. The user takes recoil.

name: Shell Rack
description: Pulls into its rack-mount shell. Raises Hardening.

name: Rack Ram
description: Rams with the full weight of a 2U server. May Overheat the foe.

name: Hot Swap
description: Swaps in fresh drives without stopping. Raises Hardening and Encryption.

name: Hot Aisle
description: Vents the server's hot air at the foe. May Overheat it.

name: Cold Boot
description: Restarts from power-off and slams into the foe. The user takes recoil.

name: Case Hide
description: Hides inside its case. Raises Hardening.

name: Pincer Press
description: Pinches hard with a claw. May Overheat the foe.

name: Turbo Boost
description: Hits the turbo button on its case. Sharply raises Throughput.

name: Factory Reset
description: Wipes the foe back to factory settings. The user takes recoil.

name: Bit Flip
description: Flips the foe's bits from 0 to 1 and back, twice.

name: Mandible Clamp
description: Clamps on with gold-plated jaws. May Overheat the foe.

name: Swarm Clock
description: The whole colony ticks faster. Sharply raises Throughput.

name: Solder Bite
description: Bites with a tip of hot solder. May Overheat the foe.

name: Thick Hide
description: Toughens its rubbery hide. Raises Hardening.

name: Belly Flop
description: Flops its whole cooled bulk onto the foe. May Overheat it.

name: Pump Surge
description: Floods the loop until the pump bursts. The user takes recoil.

name: Roll Up
description: Curls into a ball of aluminum bands. Raises Hardening.

name: Platter Roll
description: Rolls into the foe at 7,200 rpm. May Overheat it.

name: Head Crash
description: Slams its read head into the foe. Click. The user takes recoil.

name: Paste Coat
description: Coats itself in thermal paste. Raises Hardening.

name: Thermal Smear
description: Smears hot paste across the foe. May Overheat it.

name: Reapply
description: Wipes off the old paste and applies fresh. Restores half its Uptime.

name: Hot Trail
description: Leaves a silver trail that's still hot. May Overheat the foe.

name: Double Buffer
description: Draws the next frame while the first one hits. Strikes twice.

name: Boost Clock
description: Pushes its GPU clock past stock. Sharply raises Throughput.

name: Ray Trace
description: Traces every ray of light into the foe. May Overheat it.

name: Chirp
description: A sharp chirp that echoes off every rack.

name: Zip Tie
description: Darts in and zips the foe up tight. Always goes first.

name: Nest Weave
description: Weaves a nest of tidy cables around itself. Raises Hardening.

name: Cable Storm
description: Whips every loose cable in the room at the foe.

name: Node Pulse
description: Pulses down its thread to every node at once.

name: Sticky Silk
description: Strings sticky silk over the foe's ports. Throttles it.

name: Silk Dash
description: Drops down its thread and strikes. Always goes first.

name: Mesh Flood
description: Every strand of the mesh sends traffic at the foe.

name: Web Cache
description: Stores spare silk for later. Sharply raises Bandwidth.

name: Sonar
description: Clicks a sonar pulse that bounces off the foe.

name: Whale Song
description: A long, slow song that drags the foe's timing out. Throttles it.

name: Breach
description: Leaps out of the water at the foe. Always goes first.

name: Light Wave
description: A wave of glowing light rolls through the foe.

name: Quick Mask
description: Strikes from behind a fake address. Always goes first.

name: Relay Hop
description: Hops between two relays and strikes from each, twice.

name: Spoof
description: Answers for the foe with fake replies. Throttles it.

name: Burrow Cache
description: Hides a stash in its burrow. Sharply raises Bandwidth.

name: Onion Route
description: Wraps an attack in layer after layer, then unwraps it on the foe.

name: Dial Tone
description: A steady tone that never stops.

name: Baud Beat
description: Beats its wings at 56k, hitting twice.

name: Line Noise
description: Fills the foe's line with static. Throttles it.

name: Modem Screech
description: The full dial-up handshake, at full volume.

name: Static Pulse
description: Its dome pulses with static. May Throttle the foe.

name: Dead Spot
description: Drifts over the foe and drops it to one bar. Throttles it.

name: Signal Drift
description: Its signal drifts and stings. May lower the foe's Hardening.

name: Tentacle Surge
description: Every tentacle discharges at once. May Throttle the foe.

name: Chatter
description: The whole flock chatters at once.

name: Swoop
description: Dives at the foe before it can react. Always goes first.

name: Flock Net
description: The flock closes in around the foe. Sharply lowers its Bandwidth.

name: Flock Storm
description: Thousands of little nodes pour through the foe.

name: Bill Clack
description: Clacks its long bill. The sound carries for miles.

name: Express Drop
description: Drops a package on the foe before it can move. Always goes first.

name: Cached Copy
description: Restores itself from a cached copy. Restores half its Uptime.

name: Checkbox Swipe
description: Swats the foe like a stubborn "I'm not a robot" box.

name: Distorted Text
description: Flashes squiggly, unreadable letters. May lower the foe's accuracy.

name: Prove You're Human
description: Asks the foe to select every square with a traffic light. It starts Looping.

name: Image Grid
description: Slams a 3x3 grid of blurry photos down on the foe.

name: Lure Link
description: Waves a glowing fake link. Clicking it may leave the foe Infected.

name: Fake Login
description: Shows a login page that looks almost right. The foe types its password in. Sharply lowers its Encryption.

name: Credential Harvest
description: Reels in the foe's stolen logins. Heals the user by half the damage dealt.

name: Spoofed Sender
description: An email that claims to be from the boss. It is not from the boss.

name: Data Drizzle
description: Rains small packets on the foe 2 to 4 times.

name: Fleece Fog
description: Puffs up its wool into a fog. Raises the user's evasion.

name: Static Wool
description: Rubs its fleece until it sparks. May leave the foe Throttled.

name: Downpour Sync
description: Syncs everything at once. A downpour of files floods the foe.

name: Edge Hop
description: Hops to the edge of the network and lands on the foe.

name: Fog Bank
description: Rolls a bank of fog over the foe. Lowers its accuracy.

name: Bubble Sort
description: Blows data bubbles and swaps them into order, 2 to 5 times. Slowly.

name: Edge Leap
description: Leaps from the cloud's edge with all its weight. Lower latency, bigger splash.

name: Free Trial
description: Swoops in with an offer that's free for now.

name: Fry Snatch
description: Steals a bite of the foe's lunch. Heals the user by half the damage.

name: Price Hike
description: Raises its prices for no reason. Sharply raises the user's Throughput.

name: Surprise Invoice
description: Bills the foe for every feature it never used. May leave it Throttled.

name: Invoke
description: Gets called once, runs once, and spits the result at the foe.

name: Cold Start
description: Takes a moment to wake up, then hits hard. Nobody likes waiting for it.

name: Stateless
description: Forgets everything between calls, including the foe's tricks. Raises the user's Compute and Encryption.

name: Timeout
description: Runs the clock all the way to fifteen minutes. May leave the foe Hung.

name: Auto Scale
description: Spins up more copies of itself under load. Raises the user's Throughput and Bandwidth.

name: Packet Bubble
description: Spits a bubble with one packet inside.

name: Puff Up
description: Swallows incoming data and swells up. Sharply raises the user's Hardening.

name: Spine Check
description: Puffs out its spines into the foe. May lower the foe's Hardening.

name: Buffer Overflow
description: Takes in more than it can hold and lets it all spill out. The user takes recoil.

name: Sync Spin
description: Spins the arrows on its head and pushes a change at the foe.

name: Delta Nibble
description: Only bites the parts that changed.

name: Conflicted Copy
description: Saves two versions of the foe at once. Leaves it Looping.

name: Cold Storage
description: Packs itself into its archive box. Raises the user's Hardening and Encryption.

name: Archive Gust
description: Beats its wings and blows a year of old files at the foe.

name: Copy Peck
description: Pecks the foe, then pecks a copy of the foe, just in case.

name: Duplicate
description: Sends the same packet twice. Hits 2 times.

name: Mirror Set
description: Mirrors itself onto a second drive. Raises the user's evasion and Hardening.

name: Great Migration
description: Moves a whole flock's data across the valley through the foe. May leave it Throttled.

name: Memory Leak
description: Never gives back what it took in, and it all leaks onto the foe. May lower the foe's Hardening.

name: Jet Lag
description: Drags the foe across nine time zones. Puts it on Standby.

name: Honey Dip
description: Dips a paw in the pot and swats the foe. Sticky.

name: Sticky Trap
description: Leaves the pot open. The foe walks right in and gets stuck. Sharply lowers its Bandwidth.

name: Don't Care
description: Doesn't care what the foe does. Raises the user's Throughput and Hardening.

name: Honeypot
description: Lets the foe hack a fake server, then logs everything it tried. May leave the foe Hung.

name: Shiny Pick
description: Plucks something blue off the foe for its collection.

name: Sort Display
description: Lines up its collection by shade of blue. Raises the user's evasion and Encryption.

name: Merge Sort
description: Splits the foe in half, sorts each half and merges them back together. Ouch.

name: Quick Sort
description: Usually very fast. Sometimes it picks a bad pivot and misses.

name: Cell Roll
description: Curls into a ball of cells and rolls into the foe.

name: Autofill
description: Drags the corner down and fills the foe with copies of the last hit. Hits 2 to 5 times.

name: Circular Reference
description: Points a cell back at itself. The foe can't stop recalculating. Leaves it Looping.

name: Ref Error
description: Deletes the column the foe was looking at. May lower its accuracy.

name: Prompt Sting
description: Pokes a sign-in prompt straight into the foe.

name: Second Factor
description: Stings once for the password and once for the code. Hits 2 times.

name: Push Fatigue
description: Sends sign-in prompts until the foe taps Approve just to make it stop. Sharply lowers its Encryption.

name: One-Time Code
description: Stings with a six-digit code that runs out in thirty seconds. May leave the foe Throttled.

name: Timestamp
description: Clamps the foe and stamps the exact time it happened.

name: Log Rotate
description: Rolls up its old log and backs into a fresh one. Sharply raises the user's Hardening.

name: Verbose
description: Writes down every little thing the foe does, out loud. Lowers its Compute and Bandwidth.

name: Tail Follow
description: Follows the foe and reads every new line as it happens. May lower its Encryption.

name: RAM Glide
description: Glides in low and slaps the foe with a wing full of RAM.

name: Dual Channel
description: Runs both wings in dual channel. Sharply raises the user's Bandwidth.

name: Out of Bounds
description: Reads one slot past the end of the array and hits the foe with whatever is there.

name: Page Swap
description: Swaps the foe out to slow storage. May lower its Bandwidth.

name: Status Ping
description: Stands up tall and pings the foe to see if it's up.

name: Sentry Watch
description: Keeps watch from the top of its hill. Raises the user's accuracy and evasion.

name: Heartbeat
description: Thumps the foe once per heartbeat. Hits 2 to 3 times.

name: Outage Alert
description: Every light on its belt goes red at once. May leave the foe Throttled.

name: Gnaw Byte
description: Gnaws off exactly eight bits of the foe.

name: Grid Slap
description: Slaps the foe with its flat, grid-patterned tail.

name: Dam Up
description: Stacks blocks into a little wall. Raises the user's Hardening and Compute.

name: Data Lake
description: Opens the dam and floods the foe with everything it was holding back. May lower its Bandwidth.

name: Log Jam
description: Drops a stack of logs that jams the foe's pipeline. May leave it Hung.

name: Lock Roll
description: Curls up into a locked ball and rolls into the foe.

name: Encrypt
description: Locks every scale it has. Sharply raises the user's Encryption.

name: Scale Shot
description: Flicks locked scales at the foe. Hits 2 to 5 times.

name: Deadbolt
description: Slams shut on the foe like a deadbolt.

name: Lockout
description: Too many wrong guesses: the foe is locked out for a while. May leave it Hung.

name: Acorn Toss
description: Throws an acorn it was saving for later.

name: Cache Hit
description: Grabs a snack it cached earlier. Restores half of the user's max Uptime.

name: Cache Miss
description: Digs for an acorn that isn't there and bonks the foe instead. May lower its accuracy.

name: Hoard
description: Stuffs everything it can find into its fur. Sharply raises the user's Compute.

name: Disk Full
description: Dumps its whole, overstuffed drive on the foe.

name: Quick Scan
description: Sweeps its visor over the foe.

name: Fingerprint
description: Learns the foe's signature, so it can't hide. Sharply lowers its evasion.

name: Heuristic
description: Guesses where the foe is weak and swings there. May lower its Hardening.

name: Isolate
description: Seals the foe in a see-through cube to watch what it does. Puts it on Standby.

name: Full Scan
description: Checks every file the foe has, one at a time. May lower its Encryption.

name: Fetch Key
description: Fetches a key and bonks the foe with it.

name: Guard Bark
description: Barks at the door. Lowers the foe's Throughput.

name: Key Jangle
description: Shakes its key ring right in the foe's ear. May leave it Throttled.

name: Token Bite
description: Bites down with a fresh session token.

name: Master Key
description: Picks out the key that opens every door. Raises the user's Throughput and Encryption.

name: Single Sign-On
description: Signs in once and charges through every door at the same time.

name: Access Denied
description: Slams the door on the foe at every gateway. May lower its Throughput.
